title: How much does ho chi minh food cost a day
paragraphs: Me and a friend arrived in ho chi minh yesterday and our accomadation is in district 1. All the food options around here seem to be very expensive to what we’re used to paying, I suppose that’s what we get for staying central. Are we missing something, there are a lot of restaurants I notice with a lot of Vietnamese people eating there which seem on the cheaper side but there’s no menus or anything. The ones with menus in English all seem to be quite expensive.
Are there any places you recommend to eat around d1 that is a bit better value for money.
